Transport Secretary Sean Duffy is being ridiculed online after a video resurfaced of him gushing over a young actress’ breasts in front of his wife, jokingly saying they were “gonna save America.

“Sydney Sweeney’s boobs make us want to reproduce,” Duffy said enthusiastically in front of his wife, Fox News host Rachel Campos-Duffy, in a 2024 episode of “From the Kitchen Table: The Duffys.” “Sydney Sweeney’s boobs are gonna save America.”

Sweeney, who was discovered to be a registered Republican last year, was dubbed a “MAGA Barbie” following backlash over a controversial American Eagle campaign that some online say promoted eugenics.

“If we’re honest, men appreciate women, and men that appreciate women are not toxic. God made us a certain way to appreciate and want to mate with a woman, and women are made the same way to want to be with a man,” Duffy said in 2024.

He told his wife, who was the one to initially ask him to comment on the actress’ breasts, “I think Sydney Sweeney is just a reminder that men are still men.”

“I’m sorry, we are,” Duffy said as his wife laughed. “And women are still women and that’s OK!”

Duffy recently emerged from more mockery after claiming his daughter would be at risk of becoming “perverted and contorted” if she attended Harvard University.

His claim about his daughter did not age well after his comments about Sweeney’s breasts resurfaced and users online chimed in immediately to mock him.
